prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1362; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and low back pain, along with stiffness and reduced range of motion in both regions. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with that mechanism. Cervical and lumbar examination findings were objective, including documented muscle guarding and limited motion, and imaging studies clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to both areas. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar spine is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered over eleven visits, consisting of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graduated activity instruction. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type, reflecting a slower functional recovery. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered with no repeated or duplicate charges. The patient has been advised to continue home exercises and to return if symptoms worsen.
